source.quote: Pro-Ject Audio Systems' own page for the DAC Box RS2, read 2026-11-25. Digital inputs: « 1 x USB 2.0 Audio 32/768 + DoP and Native-DSD up to DSD512 »; « 2 x S/PDIF optical 24/192 »; « 1 x S/PDIF coaxial 24/192 »; « 1x AES/EBU balanced 24/192 »; « 1 x HDMI I2S for CD Box RS2 T ». DAC: « 2x ESS9038Q2M (dual mono - 32bit/768kHz/DSD512) ». Filters: no specification row; the body text says « The DAC Box RS2 has eight digital filters. » Feature list: « High Quality optionally selectable upsampling of PCM and/or MQA content with propriatory filtering » - the misspelling is the page's.

device_settings.why: « High Quality optionally selectable upsampling of PCM and/or MQA content with propriatory filtering ». Optional and the owner's choice, so left off for the same reason as LUMIN's and FiiO's: Auto has already chosen the rate and designed the filter, and a device-side resampler with a proprietary filter would redo that work with something we cannot account for.

_verification_des_conditions_faite_et_pr: project-audio.com has NO terms-of-use page: the footer links an Imprint, a Data protection declaration, software updates, contact, FAQ, warranty, dealers and downloads, and nothing named Terms. The Imprint and the Data protection declaration were both READ and neither restricts copying, reproduction or extraction of site content. The footer carries « (c) 2026 Pro-Ject Audio Systems a division of Audio Tuning Vertriebs GmbH », which is the ordinary copyright line. One restriction does exist on the data-protection page and it is scoped to security research, inside a Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure policy: « You must not, for example, share, redistribute or fail to properly secure data retrieved from the systems or services » - about data obtained while reporting a vulnerability, not about published specifications. Recorded in full because three makers were refused the same day on clauses this specific.
_une_entree_I2S_reservee_a_UN_appareil: « 1 x HDMI I2S for CD Box RS2 T » - an I2S input over an HDMI connector whose stated purpose is to receive one named transport of the same maker. The i2s block is written EMPTY: the socket exists and the page rates it nowhere. Fifth proprietary link in the catalogue whose figures are unpublished, after MSB's Pro ISL, Nagra's NAGRA-LINK, Wadax's triple-AES and EMM Labs' Optilink - and the first that the maker gives a standard name and a standard connector while still rating it not at all.
_huit_filtres_annonces_dans_le_corps_et_: « The DAC Box RS2 has eight digital filters. » In prose, not in the specification table, and not one of the eight is named. No device_settings entry for them. Sixth maker to state a filter COUNT and withhold the list, after Berkeley, FiiO, Matrix, Chord's Hugo TT 2 and Luxman - and the Topping DX1 II, read an hour earlier, shows what the list looks like when a maker does publish it.
